about: Colorcode Reader rack types. The reader works out the rack type from the tube and rack IDs it reads, then uses that type's settings. Edit here, or press Download settings file in the reader and put the file next to index.html. A type with "labels": "colorcode" is used when most tubes are read from color rings; its tubeId pattern is only a fallback. "noRackBarcode": true means no rack barcode is looked for.
